pages.description: Wearing a blocky hard hat, Minecraft Alex works quietly on a bridge on this printable coloring page, carrying a patterned cube between its rope lined rails. Wooden posts follow the narrow deck toward a distant tower, while angular rock ledges drop away beneath the suspended walkway.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Carrying Materials In A Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Alex carries building materials through a forest on this printable coloring page, cradling several stacked blocks with different textures against the front of her body. A zigzag path runs beneath her feet, while tall straight trunks, broad square canopies, and sparse grass frame her walking pose.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Watching Quietly In A Castle Base Coloring Page
pages.description: Seated on a stone ledge, Minecraft Alex watches quietly inside a castle base on this printable coloring page, her feet hanging over the patterned block wall. Towers and a deep doorway rise behind her, with wall mounted torches, distant trees, and a stepped hill visible through the gap.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Exploring Slowly Near A Farm Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Alex explores near a farm field on this printable coloring page, walking with a pickaxe and round compass beside a straight row of crops. A fenced barn stands behind the plants, with crossed panels on its double doors, a curved roof, and small clouds overhead.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Walking With Tools In A Treehouse Base Coloring Page
pages.description: High in a treehouse base, Minecraft Alex walks with tools on this printable coloring page, crossing a fenced wooden bridge with a pickaxe and sword in hand. A ladder descends beside the huge trunk to a lower platform holding a chest, while mountains rise beyond the canopy.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Holding Building Blocks In A Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Alex holds building blocks in a meadow on this printable coloring page, balancing three plain cubes stacked from largest to smallest against her chest. A round sun hangs above the open scene, and square topped trees, low bushes, and scattered grass surround her upright figure.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Looking Into The Distance In A Survival Base Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Alex looks into the distance from a survival base on this printable coloring page, standing beside a fenced crop patch in front of a small house. The building has a stepped roof and several windows, with a furnace outside and pointed mountains behind the nearby trees.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Standing With A Pickaxe In The End Dimension Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Alex stands with a pickaxe in the End dimension on this printable coloring page, surrounded by dark platforms and tall pillars topped with geometric ornaments. Three long limbed figures occupy nearby gaps, while a narrow path links the raised blocks around her central standing position.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Working Quietly On An End Island Coloring Page
pages.description: On an End island, Minecraft Alex works quietly on this printable coloring page, kneeling with a pickaxe among flowers beside a smaller blocky figure. Two little floating islands rise behind the main rocky platform, with sparse plants, flat clouds, and a large round sun overhead.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Studying The Surroundings Inside A House Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Alex studies her surroundings inside a house on this printable coloring page, raising one hand to her forehead while holding a pickaxe in the other. A table and chair stand beside her, with a burning fireplace, tall brick chimney, and large window completing the room.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Carrying Tools Near A Farm Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Alex carries tools near a farm field on this printable coloring page, holding a pickaxe in each hand beside a low wooden fence. Rows of tall crops and several round pumpkins fill the enclosed beds, with a small shed and square topped trees in the distance.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Standing With Tools In A Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: A pickaxe and sword accompany Minecraft Alex on this printable coloring page as she stands with her tools in a forest of tall blocky trees. Small flowers grow beside the zigzag path, while square markings decorate the broad canopies beneath a large round sun.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Holding Equipment In A Jungle Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Alex holds her equipment in a jungle on this printable coloring page, carrying a pickaxe and sword beside a waterfall dropping into a small pool. Long vines hang from the square tree canopies, with broad split leaves, low shrubs, and scattered blocks surrounding her feet.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Standing Calmly Near A River Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Alex stands calmly near a river on this printable coloring page, looking across the winding water from a narrow ledge along its stepped bank. Several low rocks interrupt the current, while blocky trees, small flowers, and bushes extend along the far side of the framed scene.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Exploring Curiously In A Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Alex explores a forest curiously on this printable coloring page, shading her eyes with one hand while carrying a small telescope in the other. A stepping stone path leads between large blocks and tall trees, with flowers and a blocky chicken visible beside the trail.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Crawling Calmly In Sunflower Plains Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Alex crawls calmly through sunflower plains on this printable coloring page, smiling with both hands planted on the ground beneath her shoulders. Large flowers rise behind her bent legs, and rows of angular plants and long flat clouds create a simple background above the open foreground.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Sitting Calmly In A Desert Coloring Page
pages.description: Between tall cacti, Minecraft Alex sits calmly in a desert on this printable coloring page, resting on a low block with her legs extended forward. A braid falls over her shoulder, while scattered rocks, stepped sand ledges, flat clouds, and a tilted square sun surround her.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Digging Carefully In A Jungle Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Alex digs carefully in a jungle on this printable coloring page, bending over a small hole with a pickaxe held above several loose blocks. Palm shaped trees, curling vines, thick trunks, and overlapping shrubs fill the background, creating a dense border around the open work area.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Watching Calmly In A Bamboo Jungle Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Alex watches calmly in a bamboo jungle on this printable coloring page, standing among tall segmented stalks with pairs of pointed leaves branching from their joints. Two small patterned cubes sit near her feet, and scattered grass grows along the edges of the low ground platform.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Playing Happily In Sunflower Plains Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Alex plays happily in sunflower plains on this printable coloring page, smiling broadly with one knee lifted and a large tool raised beside her. Tall flowers surround her lively pose, while a curling ponytail, low rolling hills, clouds, and a partly hidden sun complete the scene.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Relaxing Peacefully Near A Farm Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Alex relaxes peacefully near a farm field on this printable coloring page, reclining with a closed eye smile and her legs stretched across the foreground. Rows of crops, large pumpkins, a fenced barn, and flat clouds spread behind her beneath a sun with long straight rays.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Looking Around Curiously in a Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Alex looks around curiously in a village on this printable coloring page, standing beside a stone well between small houses with layered stepped roofs. Square windows, trimmed block shaped bushes, and a tall tree add detail around the central figure and the well's simple wooden supports.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Holding An Apple Near A Portal Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Alex holds an apple near a portal on this printable coloring page, standing beside a tall rounded frame filled with spirals and small circles. The apple rests above her raised hand, while blocky trees and flat clouds add a simple landscape behind the two central shapes.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Roaring Playfully On A Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Alex roars playfully on a bridge on this printable coloring page, lifting both arms with her mouth open and a small satchel hanging at her side. The arched stone crossing spans a winding stream dotted with rocks, while sharp mountains and square topped trees rise behind it.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Walking Happily Near A Farm Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Minecraft Alex walks happily near a farm field on this printable coloring page, smiling beside tall crops and two large pumpkins in front of a fence. Two blocky sheep stand inside the enclosure, with a wooden barn, scattered trees, rounded clouds, and a jagged sun beyond them.

pages.title: Minecraft Alex Looking at the Sky in Snowy Tundra Coloring Page
pages.description: Large snowflakes drift above Minecraft Alex on this printable coloring page as she looks at the sky in a snowy tundra with both arms raised. Rounded snowbanks roll behind her, while tiered evergreen trees, small stones, and a few low plants dot the otherwise open winter landscape.
